task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OIDC-04 at src/design/oidc-04-standards-compliance-boundary.md. Define a provider-agnostic standards-compliance boundary that uses only OIDC discovery document resolution, JWKS key retrieval, and standard claim set semantics (iss, sub, aud, exp, nbf, iat). Specify how provider-specific token extensions are excluded from core authentication flow while preserving extensibility in adapters. Include module boundaries, verifier pipeline stages, error contracts, and test seams that prove any OIDC-compliant discovery URL can be used without code changes. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines OIDC-04 standards boundary using discovery document plus JWKS plus standard claims only
Design explicitly prevents provider-specific token extensions from being required in core auth
Design maps OIDC-04 acceptance criteria to concrete validation and test points
Design identifies backend touchpoints for Step 02 implementation and Step 03/04 testing
Design preserves provider-agnostic behavior outside adapter-specific modules

result.summary: Designed OIDC-04 standards-compliance boundary at src/design/oidc-04-standards-compliance-boundary.md with standards-only verifier pipeline, provider-agnostic module boundaries, typed error contracts, and acceptance-criteria traceability to concrete validation/test points.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for standards verifier implementation, then TEST-DESIGNER (Step 03) and TEST-RUNNER (Step 04) for OIDC-04 boundary compliance coverage.
